spec_evidence.checked: Cached twilio_api_v2010 specs: at 1.10.0 issues[] items were typed objects carrying count, description and percentage_of_total_calls; from 1.20.0 the items schema is untyped and the current spec describes issues as a flat list of issue labels (imperfect-audio, dropped-call, ...). No other endpoint in any cached version exposes per-issue aggregate counts.

fix.migration_guide: The per-issue aggregate metrics (count, description, percentage_of_total_calls) were discontinued, not relocated: issues is now a plain array of issue label strings and no Twilio endpoint returns the old aggregates. A codemod cannot mend this because the data itself no longer exists upstream. Teams that depend on those metrics must make a product decision: derive equivalent aggregates by collecting per-call feedback events into their own analytics store, or drop the metric. The only mechanical assistance possible is defensive: treat issues entries as strings and remove property access on them.
fix.example_before: const worst = summary.issues.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)[0];
fix.example_after: const labels = summary.issues; // plain issue label strings; aggregates discontinued upstream
